claims.subject: Candidate Processor
claims.evidence_quote: To ensure that any message received by at least one non-faulty candidate is eventually delivered to all nonfaulty candidates, we require each candidate to broadcast every newly received message to all other candidate processors.

claims.subject: Token
claims.evidence_quote: In case, for some updated τ, |T (x)| > τ then ⌊|T (x)|∕τ⌋ number of tokens are sent as a message one by one from the processor x.

claims.subject: Message Broadcast
claims.evidence_quote: As |T (x)| becomes more than or equal to τ, x sends a message to all the candidate processors containing the round number in which x sent the message to candidate processors, ID of x and τ.

claims.subject: Phase 2
claims.evidence_quote: Phase 2: This phase gets activated when the number of counting triggers is less than 2n.

claims.subject: Trigger
claims.evidence_quote: Consequently, this phase requires at most lg w updation of τ, where w is the overall triggers that occur before the alert is raised.
